_note: Which share card each page shows on X, iMessage, Discord, Slack and the rest. Masters are og/src/<card>.webp, made by MLow 2026-10-03. build_og.py turns them into assets/og/<card>-<hash>.jpg at 1200x630 and writes them into each page. 'default' also becomes og.jpg, the card every page not listed here falls back to. 'folders' lists page folders (piece pages n/, museum rooms rooms/) that take a banner each, picked from 'rotation' by a stable hash of the file name, so neighbours differ and a page keeps its banner from build to build. Their JSON-LD image stays the piece or room, for search.
